agenda: MT2 v4 EXPERIMENT (explicitly not a mainlined change): does a local geometric channel -- the incumbent's family-portable ingredient, expressed as exact relational invariants -- buy cross-family transfer without selling the in-family gains? Heilmeier writeup: conversation 2026-08-13; evidence basis sec-nb-mt2-stage0-synthesis.

design.added_channel: flag-gated (use_local_features, DEFAULT FALSE): per-point measure-weighted Gaussian-kernel patch integrals at two physical radii (0.01, 0.03 in the L_ref=8 gauge; ~0.4 m and ~1.2 m): mean neighbor normal (dots with n_i and d, magnitude as curvature proxy), mean displacement (dots with n_i and d, magnitude as concavity/skew proxy), patch mass -- 7 invariants x 2 radii appended to the seed invariants (5 -> 19)
design.why_radius_not_knn: physical radii are sampling-density-robust in expectation (kNN would re-import the density defect); measure weights make the patch integrals unbiased under HT sampling
design.equivariance: exact by construction (integrals of equivariant vectors, dotted against n_i and d); contract tests gate launch

arms.mt2_v4_seed{42,43,44}: v3c + local channel on, frozen protocol, full instrument

deciding_gates.V4_1_transfer: zero-shot < 0.85 on both families (v3c: 0.95-1.03; 0b's 0.70-0.80 is the aspiration)
deciding_gates.V4_3_density: not worse than v3c's 13-14x (the measure-weighted patch design should be neutral)
deciding_gates.STRETCH: zero-shot <= 0.80 AND in-family <= 1.20x: dominates every existing MT2 cell

predictions.failure_reading: if local features do not transfer, the anti-correlation is a one-family-training property, and stage 1 pivots to training diversity (the reverse-probe hint) with architecture work de-emphasized
